topic: Electronics fundamentals — voltage, current, resistance, capacitors, and circuit analysis. Contextualized around diagnosing and fixing circuits for a quadruped robot (Pupper v3). Player must reason about Ohm's law, voltage dividers, capacitor behavior, communication protocols (I2C, SPI, CAN), and component selection to progress.

iterations.biggest_risk: RPG mechanics are purely cosmetic — stats, inventory, tools, and class abilities have no mechanical effect
